cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(scr C)
enable_testing()
add_executable(prog prog.c)
add_test(NAME prog_ok COMMAND prog)
add_test(NAME script_ok COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/check.script)
add_test(NAME wrap_ok COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DPROG=$<TARGET_FILE:prog> -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wrap.script)
add_test(NAME always_ok COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/always.script)
